  <section id="manifest-file">
<span id="manifest"></span><h1>Manifest File<a class="headerlink" href="#manifest-file" title="Link to this heading">¶</a></h1>
<div class="admonition note">
<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
<p>Keys must always be represented even when the value is optional.
If the key is not needed/available the value may be empty.</p>
</div>
<p>Resource Containers (RCs) have a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">manifest.yaml</span></code> file that describes its content and structure.
Most of the information adheres to the <a class="reference external" href="http://dublincore.org/documents/dcmi-terms">Dublin Core Meta Data Initiative</a>
and can be found nested within the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">dublin_core</span></code> key.</p>
<div class="highlight-yaml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nn">---</span>
<span class="nt">dublin_core</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">conformsto</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;rc0.2&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">contributor</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;A</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Contributor&#39;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;Another</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Contributor&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">creator</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;Someone</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Or</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Organization&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">description</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;One</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">or</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">two</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">sentence</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">description</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">of</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">the</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">resource.&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">format</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;text/usfm&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">identifier</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;ulb&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">issued</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;2015-12-17&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">language</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nt">identifier</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;en&#39;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nt">title</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;English&#39;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nt">direction</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;ltr&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">modified</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;2015-12-22T12:01:30-05:00&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">publisher</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;Name</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">of</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Publisher&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">relation</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;en/udb&#39;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;el-x-koine/ugnt?v=0.7&#39;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;en/tn&#39;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;en/tq&#39;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;en/tw&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">rights</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;CC</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">BY-SA</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">4.0&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">source</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="nt">identifier</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;asv&#39;</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="nt">language</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;en&#39;</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="nt">version</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;1901&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">subject</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;Bible&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">title</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;Unlocked</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Literal</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Bible&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;book&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">version</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;3&#39;</span>

<span class="nt">checking</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">checking_entity</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;Organization</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">or</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Church</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">network&#39;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;Organization</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">or</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Church</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">network&#39;</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">checking_level</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;3&#39;</span>

<span class="nt">projects</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nt">categories</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">            </span><span class="p p-Indicator">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;bible-ot&#39;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nt">identifier</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;gen&#39;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nt">path</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;./content&#39;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nt">sort</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">1</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nt">title</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;Genesis&#39;</span>
<span class="w">        </span><span class="nt">versification</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#39;kjv&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<section id="definitions">
<span id="manifest-definitions"></span><h2>Definitions<a class="headerlink" href="#definitions" title="Link to this heading">¶</a></h2>
<ul>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">dublin_core</span></code></p>
<blockquote>
<div><ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">conformsto</span></code>: the version of this specification used by the RC.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">contributor</span></code>: an array of names or aliases of people that have contributed to the resource.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">creator</span></code>: the entity in charge of creating the resource.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">description</span></code>: a brief description of what the resource is.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">format</span></code>: the file format of content within the RC, e.g. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text/usfm</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text/markdown</span></code> etc.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">identifier</span></code>: a <a class="reference internal" href="slug.html#identifier"><span class="std std-ref">Identifier</span></a> formatted string uniquely identifying the resource.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">issued</span></code>: the <a class="reference internal" href="date.html#date"><span class="std std-ref">Date</span></a> of publication. Normally this should stay in sync with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">version</span></code> increments.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">language</span></code>: the language of the resource.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">modified</span></code>: the date the resource was last modified. Occassionally, this may be more recent than <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">issued</span></code> if there are metadata changes that do not include changes to the content.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">publisher</span></code>: the name of the entity that published the resource.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">relation</span></code>:  an array of <a class="reference internal" href="linking.html#short-links"><span class="std std-ref">Short Links</span></a> to related resources. A version parameter (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">v</span></code>) may be provided if you want to link to a specific version of the resource. If a version number is not included then any version should satisfy the relation.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">rights</span></code>: the license under which the resource is distributed.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">title</span></code>: the title of the resource</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">type</span></code>: the RC <a class="reference internal" href="container_types.html#types"><span class="std std-ref">container type</span></a>.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">version</span></code>: the published iteration of the resource.</p></li>
</ul>
</div></blockquote>
</li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">projects</span></code>: an array of projects inside the RC.</p>
<blockquote>
<div><ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">categories</span></code>: an array of category <a class="reference internal" href="slug.html#identifier"><span class="std std-ref">identifiers</span></a> used for hierarchical ordering.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">identifier</span></code>: an <a class="reference internal" href="slug.html#identifier"><span class="std std-ref">Identifier</span></a> formatted string uniquely identifying the project.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">path</span></code>: the relative path to the project within the RC. Depending on the RC type this may be a directory or a file.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sort</span></code>: the sorting order of this project when viewed in relation to other projects in this RC.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">title</span></code>: the title of the project.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">versification</span></code>: the system used for placing verse markers and consequently chunk markers.</p></li>
</ul>
</div></blockquote>
</li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="generating-from-usfm">
<h2>Generating From USFM<a class="headerlink" href="#generating-from-usfm" title="Link to this heading">¶</a></h2>
<p>See <a class="reference internal" href="usfm_manifest.html#usfm-manifest"><span class="std std-ref">USFM to Manifest</span></a> for instructions on populating the manifest.yaml from the headers in a usfm file.</p>
</section>
